stage.note: STACKIT is a cloud brand/business unit of Schwarz Digits, itself part of the privately-held Schwarz Group (owner of Lidl and Kaufland). Not independently funded; no VC rounds found or expected for a captive hyperscaler unit of a private retail conglomerate.

revenue.basis: Parent Schwarz Group's consolidated FY2025 revenue (Wikipedia infobox, citing Schwarz Group reporting) was EUR 185.6bn, converted to USD at roughly the period-average EUR/USD rate; this is the whole conglomerate's revenue (Lidl, Kaufland, Schwarz Digits/STACKIT, PreZero, etc.), not STACKIT's own revenue, which is not separately disclosed.

employees.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Schwarz_Group notes Schwarz Group has ~604,000 employees group-wide (FY2025); STACKIT/Schwarz Digits' own headcount is not separately published.

note: STACKIT is the sovereign/enterprise cloud platform operated by Schwarz Digits, the digital/IT division of Germany's privately-held Schwarz Group (owner of Lidl and Kaufland supermarket chains). It is a corporate subsidiary/business unit, not a VC-backed startup: there is no independent funding history, accelerator participation, or standalone revenue disclosure. Buyers should treat STACKIT's financial backing as that of a large, profitable, privately-held European retail conglomerate rather than a startup with disclosed funding rounds.
